title: 壩體滲流監測~Seepage monitoring in dams
focus: 以水頭流量與含砂證據辨識壩體滲流演變~Diagnosing dam seepage through head discharge and sediment evidence
summary: 本課以以水頭流量與含砂證據辨識壩體滲流演變為主線，先用總水頭與共同基準與達西流量與梯度界定水力與構造條件，再將孔壓響應與延遲、含砂濃度與輸砂連結到基線殘差與不確定度。採飽和等溫一維或集中參數示意，實際壩體可能非均質且具暫態儲水。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops diagnosing dam seepage through head discharge and sediment evidence through Total head and common datum and Darcy discharge and gradient, then connects Piezometer response and lag and Suspended concentration and sediment flux to Baseline residual and uncertainty. Saturated isothermal one-dimensional or lumped examples do not represent heterogeneous transient dam foundations. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 本課所研究的以水頭流量與含砂證據辨識壩體滲流演變，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。採飽和等溫一維或集中參數示意，實際壩體可能非均質且具暫態儲水。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。~The focus on diagnosing dam seepage through head discharge and sediment evidence reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Saturated isothermal one-dimensional or lumped examples do not represent heterogeneous transient dam foundations. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查總水頭與共同基準：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m；再獨立檢查達西流量與梯度：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。敏感度：相同幾何與滲透係數下，水頭差由12m增為15m，達西流量由0.0024增為0.0030m3/s，即增加25%；水頭降低仍流量上升才需另查通道變化。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。採飽和等溫一維或集中參數示意，實際壩體可能非均質且具暫態儲水。 將比較同季節不同水位的導水指標並核對下游水頭實測作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Total head and common datum: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m. Independently examine Darcy discharge and gradient: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s. Sensitivity: with unchanged geometry and conductivity, increasing head difference from12 to15m raises Darcy discharge from0.0024 to0.0030m3/s, or25 percent; rising flow despite falling head calls for a separate pathway investigation. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Saturated isothermal one-dimensional or lumped examples do not represent heterogeneous transient dam foundations. Use the following independent check: Compare conductance across stage bands in one season and verify measured downstream head. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 總水頭與共同基準~Total head and common datum
units.title: 總水頭與共同基準~Total head and common datum
units.mechanism: 孔壓計讀到的是量測位置的壓力，必須加上測點高程才能與庫水位比較；換用不同高程基準會製造假的水力坡降。先辨認壓力是否為表壓並扣除大氣補償，再確認管線氣泡與感測器零點，低水頭不必然代表低孔隙壓力。 驗證時應將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較，並辨識以下失效情境：壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A piezometer measures pressure at its own elevation; add elevation head before comparing it with reservoir stage. Mixing vertical datums creates a false gradient. Identify gauge versus absolute pressure and atmospheric compensation, then inspect trapped air and zero offsets; low total head does not necessarily mean low local pore pressure. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

Diagnose it by the following check: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 達西流量與梯度~Darcy discharge and gradient
units.title: 達西流量與梯度~Darcy discharge and gradient
units.mechanism: 穩定飽和滲流的流量同時受導水截面、滲透係數與水力坡降控制。排水量增加可能只是庫水頭提高，不能單憑流量認定內部沖蝕；反之通道面積改變或排水截流也會改變量測。應先建立同水位工況的比較，再檢查非線性及地下邊界。 驗證時應以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖，並辨識以下失效情境：把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Steady saturated flow depends jointly on conducting area, hydraulic conductivity and gradient. Higher drainage may merely reflect higher reservoir head and does not by itself prove internal erosion. Changing pathway area or drain interception also changes measured flow; compare like stages before interpreting nonlinearity or subsurface boundaries. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 三角堰率定水深~V-notch weir calibration
units.title: 三角堰率定水深~V-notch weir calibration
units.mechanism: 量水堰藉控制斷面把上游水頭轉成流量，三角堰指數使小水頭誤差被放大。堰尖沉積、未通氣水舌及尾水淹沒都會破壞既有率定；水深必須在適當上游位置量取，不能以貼近堰口的抽降水面代替。 驗證時應以容積計時法抽驗率定曲線並攝錄水舌與尾水高度，並辨識以下失效情境：尾水淹沒時繼續套自由溢流曲線將造成系統流量誤差。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A measuring weir converts upstream head into discharge through a controlled section, and the exponent amplifies small head errors. Deposits at the notch, an unventilated nappe or submerged tailwater invalidate calibration. Measure head at the specified upstream station rather than within the local drawdown beside the notch. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check the rating by timed-volume collection and record nappe ventilation and tailwater. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Applying a free-flow rating during submergence creates systematic discharge error. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 集水分區水量平衡~Zoned drainage water balance
units.title: 集水分區水量平衡~Zoned drainage water balance
units.mechanism: 量測槽可同時接收壩體滲水、地表逕流與維護排水，只有辨認來源才能推估穿越壩體的部分。用相同時間窗做分區平衡並檢查儲水變化；若集水坑水位持續上升，出流並不等於入流，短時事件更需保留集水系統的滯留量。 驗證時應獨立量測地表截水溝與維護排放並核對集水坑水位穩定，並辨識以下失效情境：省略集水坑蓄水變化會把抽水週期誤讀為壩體滲流脈動。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A collection channel may receive embankment seepage, surface runoff and maintenance water. Separate these sources within a common observation window and include storage change. When sump level rises, discharge is not equal to inflow; transient events require the collection system retention term rather than a simple subtraction of unmatched readings. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Meter surface interception and maintenance releases independently and verify steady sump level. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring sump storage turns pump cycling into an apparent seepage pulse. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 孔壓響應與延遲~Piezometer response and lag
units.title: 孔壓響應與延遲~Piezometer response and lag
units.mechanism: 感測器與地層的水力連通性決定水位變化多久能被量到；低滲透層或堵塞濾頭會增加延遲。簡化一階響應能解釋量測滯後，但不能把傳感器時間常數當成地層擴散參數。應將儀器試驗與庫水位事件分開分析，避免錯置因果時序。 驗證時應對照獨立孔壓計與已知水位階躍並檢查濾頭復原試驗，並辨識以下失效情境：堵塞造成慢響應可能被誤判成穩定低孔壓。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Hydraulic connection between the sensor and ground determines response time; low permeability or a clogged tip increases delay. A first-order response illustrates instrument lag but its time constant is not automatically a ground diffusivity. Separate sensor response testing from reservoir events before assigning a causal order to observed changes. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare an independent piezometer during a known stage change and inspect tip recovery tests. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Clogging-induced slow response can be mistaken for stable low pore pressure. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 水溫黏度與流量~Temperature viscosity and discharge
units.title: 水溫黏度與流量~Temperature viscosity and discharge
units.mechanism: 水的動黏度變化會影響同一孔隙結構的水力傳導，季節流量漂移不全代表材料劣化。以固定密度近似時導水率與動力黏度成反比；若介質不飽和、裂隙開度改變或水化反應發生，單一溫度修正不能恢復可比性。 驗證時應同步量測出水溫度並將同水頭的流量按黏度比正規化，並辨識以下失效情境：未補償水溫就提高警戒線可能掩蓋真正導水通道增長。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Water viscosity changes hydraulic conductivity even when pore geometry remains unchanged, so seasonal drift need not indicate deterioration. At approximately fixed density, conductivity varies inversely with dynamic viscosity. Temperature normalization cannot restore comparability if saturation, fracture aperture or chemical alteration has also changed; those require separate observations. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure outlet temperature simultaneously and normalize like-head discharge by the viscosity ratio. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Raising triggers without temperature correction can conceal genuine pathway growth. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 含砂濃度與輸砂~Suspended concentration and sediment flux
units.title: 含砂濃度與輸砂~Suspended concentration and sediment flux
units.mechanism: 濁度是光學訊號而不是直接泥砂質量，顆粒粒徑、色澤與氣泡皆會改變率定關係。要估算輸砂需採水樣測懸浮固體濃度，再與同時流量相乘；清澈水也不能排除早期內部沖蝕，因顆粒可能在下游反濾中被攔住。 驗證時應同步採取重量法水樣與濁度訊號並記錄粒徑及流量，並辨識以下失效情境：氣泡提高濁度但沒有增加固體質量會引發錯誤輸砂警報。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Turbidity is an optical signal rather than sediment mass; grain size, color and bubbles affect its calibration. Estimate sediment flux from sampled suspended concentration multiplied by simultaneous discharge. Clear water does not exclude early internal erosion because mobilized grains may remain trapped in downstream filters instead of reaching the outlet. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Pair gravimetric water samples with turbidity readings and document grain size and discharge. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Bubbles raise turbidity without adding solid mass and can trigger false sediment alarms. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 水頭正規化導水~Head-normalized hydraulic conductance
units.title: 水頭正規化導水~Head-normalized hydraulic conductance
units.mechanism: 將出流除以有效水頭差可得到整體導水指標，適合在幾何與邊界相近的工況比較。此量是流路網路的集中表現，不等於單一材料滲透係數；尾水改變、排水孔啟閉與流路重分配都能改變指標，需配合分區孔壓判讀。 驗證時應比較同季節不同水位的導水指標並核對下游水頭實測，並辨識以下失效情境：誤用固定下游水頭會在尾水升高時製造假導水變化。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Dividing outflow by effective head difference gives a bulk conductance indicator for comparable boundaries. It represents a network of pathways, not an individual material conductivity. Tailwater changes, drain operation and pathway redistribution can alter the indicator without changing soil properties, so interpret it alongside zoned pore-pressure measurements. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare conductance across stage bands in one season and verify measured downstream head. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Assuming fixed downstream head creates false conductance change when tailwater rises. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 採樣時距與偵測~Sampling interval and detection
units.title: 採樣時距與偵測~Sampling interval and detection
units.mechanism: 資料記錄頻率限制最早能看見事件的時間，通訊延遲則在此之外再增加反應時間。等間隔抽樣的平均等待只適用事件發生時相均勻且訊號持續存在；短脈衝可能完全漏記，因此應以失效發展時間與備援記錄規劃監測。 驗證時應以已知時間的測試訊號量測本地記錄到控制室顯示的延遲，並辨識以下失效情境：共同電源失效會使兩套共用電源的感測器同時失去證據。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Logging frequency limits the earliest observable change, while communication latency adds further delay. The average wait for periodic sampling assumes a uniformly distributed event phase and a persistent signal. Brief pulses may be missed entirely; choose monitoring intervals using failure-development times and independent backup logging rather than a convenient data volume. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Inject a timestamped test signal and measure latency from local logging to control-room display. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A shared power failure removes evidence from both nominally redundant sensors. units.anchor: 基線殘差與不確定度~Baseline residual and uncertainty
units.title: 基線殘差與不確定度~Baseline residual and uncertainty
units.mechanism: 預測基線應含水位、溫度與降雨等解釋變數，再對量測殘差建立誤差範圍。獨立標準不確定度可用平方和開根號組合，共同校正偏差則不能當作獨立項相消。統計異常只是調查線索，是否啟動工程處置仍依失效模式與核准程序。 驗證時應以保留資料驗證基線殘差並分列共同偏差與獨立雜訊，並辨識以下失效情境：用同一事件重新擬合基線會把新滲流異常吸收到正常模型。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A baseline should explain stage, temperature and rainfall before assigning uncertainty to residuals. Independent standard uncertainties combine by root sum of squares; shared calibration bias cannot be treated as independent cancellation. A statistical anomaly is an investigation signal, while engineering action depends on failure mechanisms and approved response procedures. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Validate baseline residuals on held-out observations and separate shared bias from independent noise. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Refitting the baseline on the event itself absorbs a new seepage anomaly into normal behavior.
